{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Craft Button.png|frameless|left]]
Craft is the menu where [[Ores]] are turned into Bars. Bars can be crafted in 1x, 5x, 50x, 500x and Max quantity, and there is also a "Craft All" button to craft all ores at once. After unlocking World 2, a cart button shows up, allowing quick-jumping to the first bar of that particular world. This quick-jump extends to future worlds once they are unlocked.

{{clear|left}}
==Craft Upgrades==
Crafting can be improved by increasing certain [[Stats#Crafting|stats]]. All of the "Craft Chance" bonuses work multiplicatively with eachother
* [[Stats#tabber-Bar_Craft_Cost|Bar Craft Cost]] - decreases amount of [[Ores]] needed per Bar to be crafted
* [[Stats#tabber-Free_Craft_Chance|Free Craft Chance]] - chance for a crafting action to not consume ore
* [[Stats#tabber-Double_Craft_Chance|Double Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 2x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-Triple_Craft_Chance|Triple Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 3x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-5x_Craft_Chance|5x Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 5x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-10x_Craft_Chance|10x Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 10x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-20x_Craft_Chance|20x Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 20x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-100x_Craft_Chance|100x Craft Chance]] - chance for a craft to give 100x bars
* [[Stats#tabber-Bar_Output_Multiplier|Bar Output Multiplier]] - provides a multiplier to total amount of bars you receive from sources of bar creation like crafting or Transmuter Bomb

==Craft Chance==
{{FakeMenuButton|image={{RandomCraftChanceImage|size=72px}}|size=72px|buttonSize=114px|styles=float:left;margin-right:5px}}
Craft multipliers are random, but you can calculate the '''average''' (expected) multiplier to estimate how many bars you’ll get on average per craft. The game itself uses this value internally when processing bulk crafts to avoid random roll overhead.<br>Each multiplier acts independently. Therefore, you can find the overall expected multiplier by calculating the expected value of each multiplier separately, then multiplying them together.

Note that if the specific crafting chance percentage exceeds 100%, there are no additional crafting bonuses.

If your chance to craft double bars is <math>p_2</math>, the expected multiplier for that bonus is:

<math>2p_2 + 1(1 - p_2) = 1 + p_2</math>

Repeating this for all multipliers and multiplying the results gives:

<math>\begin{array}{l}\mathbb{E}[\text{Total Multiplier}]=\\
(1 + p_2)(1 + 2p_3)(1 + 4p_5)(1 + 9p_{10})(1 + 19p_{20})(1 + 99p_{100})\end{array}</math>

where <math>p_n</math> is the probability of the <math>n\times</math> multiplier occurring.

=== Free Craft Chance ===
Free craft chance (<math>p_f</math>) is also independent. If you craft one bar with a chance <math>p_f</math> to not consume materials, the number of additional crafts you can perform forms an infinite geometric series:

<math>1 + p_f + p_f^2 + p_f^3 + \dots = \frac{1}{1 - p_f}</math>

===Final Formula===
Including both multiplier chances and the Bar Card bonus, the expected number of bars per craft is:

<math>\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{Bars\ per\ Craft}] = \mathrm{TotalMultiplier} \times \frac{1}{1 - p_f} \times \text{Bar Card Multiplier}</math>
